Imagine which image would be more appropriate to place in the missing spot. You can also carefully observe and compare the edges of the images.

Select from the following choices.

(A) The second image (img_2)
(B) The third image (img_3)
(C) The fourth image (img_4)
Your final answer should be formatted as \boxed{Your Choice}, for example, \boxed{A} or \boxed{B} or \boxed{C}.
